title: Added possibility to read uat tables from Lua scripts.
description:
If a new Pref uat created only with one argument, this preference is created only for reading existent uat table.

```lua
    -- Exemple for reading Protobuf Search Paths.
    proto_foo.prefs.preference_existent_uat_name = Pref.uat("Protobuf Search Paths")
    for i, row in ipairs(proto_foo.prefs.preference_existent_uat_name) do
        local row_str = ""
        for j, value in ipairs(row) do
            row_str = row_str .. value .. "\t"
        end
        print(row_str)
    end
```
This reading sequence also works on uat preferences created by Lua script.

This is an addition to the merge request !19246.
This also provides a solution to issue #19394.
